ideas.name: Stove-side child fireguard, independently tested to BS 8423
ideas.concept: Free-standing/wall-fixed 3-panel steel guard for wood stoves, designed in a Nordic profile (slim powder-coated flat bar, folds flat for storage) and type-tested to BS 8423 (fireguard standard) at a UK/EU test house; test report number printed on product and listing.
ideas.target_customer: Families with toddlers/pets and a wood stove or kamin in SE/DK homes and cabins; secondary: housing associations / daycare with stoves.
ideas.problem_solved: Hot-surface burns from stoves. Swedish forums show persistent demand for stove child-guards, and current retail guards carry no stated test standard.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Independent BS 8423 test report (est. EUR 1.5-3k, ASSUMPTION, Low confidence) that stock imported guards do not advertise; EU registered design EUR 350 for the fold profile; test-report-based marketing claim (Testix/Testfakta-style comparison sites reward documented tests). Honest limit: BS 8423 is a UK standard (no EN equivalent found), so it is a credibility mark not a legal barrier; a copycat could pay the same test fee, but would need to copy the design too (registered design) and a different product.
ideas.trend_evidence: BS 8423 exists and covers fireguards for heating appliances incl. solid fuel (BSI). Swedish forum threads on child protection round stoves have 55,826 reads. Bauhaus.se sells the Aduro kaminskydd at 1,295 SEK, so price headroom is real. Testix ran a kaminskydd-for-barn comparison updated March 2026. No source found for any EN-standard equivalent.
ideas.price_point_eur: 79-119 (anchor: Aduro 1,295 SEK ~ EUR 115 at ~11 SEK/EUR, ASSUMPTION rate)
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 28-38 per unit (ASSUMPTION, Low; steel fabrication in PL/CN/PT, MOQ 100)
ideas.one_off_tooling_eur: 800-1,500 bending/welding jigs plus EUR 350 registered design; test fee separate
ideas.channel_edge: Shopify + Google intent search (kaminskydd barn); Swedish/Danish stove retailers and chimney-sweep (sotare) networks; housing-association/daycare B2B via founders' building-industry contacts. Not verified: Amazon.de listing density.
ideas.target_customer_note: Unverified: whether BS 8423 is accepted by SE/DK retailers; ask lab for a Nordic-accepted alternative before ordering.

ideas.name: Roof-window and tall-window child-safety stopper (EN 13126-5 / EN 16281 certified), 2-pack
ideas.concept: Tool-free or screw-on opening limiter designed for angled roof windows and high-mounted sashes (where flat-window stoppers are awkward), with an opening gap fixed at the child-safe limit and a fast adult release, tested to EN 13126-5 / EN 16281.
ideas.target_customer: Parents in attic/loft rooms (roof windows), plus housing associations and landlords who must provide devices in children's rooms. Boverket requires openable windows/balcony doors where small children stay to have fall-reduction devices where the fall height is 2.0 m or more.
ideas.problem_solved: Existing stoppers are made for side-hung windows. Boverket rule creates a compliance need that housing associations and landlords must meet.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Certification: EN 13126-5 child-safety test (89 mm opening limit test, 500 N strength test per a 2020 TSS test report) or EN 16281 for consumer-fitted devices; each competitor must pay the same test to claim the mark (cost est. EUR 1.5-3k, ASSUMPTION). Plus EU registered design EUR 350 and Danish/Swedish utility model option. B2B: housing association 10-pack contracts. Honest limit: Habo and ASSA already hold EN 13126-5 for flat windows; the moat is roof-window fit, which is unverified.
ideas.trend_evidence: Habo stopper certified EN 13126-5 at 149.90 SEK (Clas Ohlson); ASSA ABLOY stopper 169 SEK (Bauhaus); ASSA 850 at 129 SEK (Hornbach). Boverket fall-height 2.0 m rule. Search found no roof-window-specific child stopper at Swedish retailers (gap not proven). prEN 13126-5 revision balloting 10 Sep 2026.
ideas.price_point_eur: 35-45 per 2-pack (competitors ~EUR 12-15 each; ASSUMPTION rate); B2B 10-pack EUR 12-15 per unit
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 4-7 per stopper (ASSUMPTION, Low; stamped steel + zinc)
ideas.one_off_tooling_eur: 2,000-3,500 stamping/die-cast tool (ASSUMPTION) plus EUR 350 design registration
ideas.channel_edge: Founders' ex-VELUX roof window knowledge and installer/housing-association relationships (fit by window model); Shopify + Amazon DE/SE; Danish almene boligselskaber. Unverified: Danish child-fall rules (search found no BR18 text).

ideas.name: Retrofit window air vent with tested airflow and sound attenuation (EN 13141-1)
ideas.concept: Slim clip-on/screw-on tilt vent for old window frames in 1960-80s flats and houses with self-draught ventilation, supplied with a manufacturer test report for airflow and sound insulation, sized for typical Nordic frame profiles.
ideas.target_customer: Housing associations, property managers and installers retrofitting old windows; villa owners with condensation and mould.
ideas.problem_solved: Old buildings rely on self-draught and window leaks for air; tighter windows cause damp. Retrofit vents are sold without comparable test data.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Test-report-based claims (EN 13141-1 airflow, acoustic data) cost est. EUR 2-4k (ASSUMPTION, Low) per variant; EU registered design EUR 350 plus Danish utility model (brugsmodel) for the baffle geometry; extrusion-profile exclusivity. B2B channel through founders' installer/housing-association contacts. Honest: competitors (Flexit, Biobe, Renson, Titon) exist; the moat is documented data plus design right, and it is the weakest of the set.
ideas.trend_evidence: Energimyndighet advice notes self-draught ventilation is most common in small houses and older flats. Flexit spaltventil and Biobe window vents are on sale in Sweden; one UK vent states BS EN 13141-1 testing. No source found for retrofit window-vent demand figures or acoustic data in Sweden.
ideas.price_point_eur: 29-45 per vent (ASSUMPTION; competitor prices not captured)
ideas.channel_edge: Ex-VELUX building-industry channel: installers, housing associations; ventilation is in their vocabulary. Not strong on Amazon.

ideas.name: Modular outdoor step anti-slip tread with DIN 51130 R-class test
ideas.concept: Interlocking recycled-rubber or aluminium-grit treads for entrance steps, sold as 3-5 step packs with printed R-class test certificate and a salt/frost durability test; designed to be shovel-safe.
ideas.target_customer: Housing associations, small landlords and villa owners with icy entrance steps; employers whose insurers recommend halkskydd at entrances.
ideas.problem_solved: Winter ice falls. About 2 in 3 serious pedestrian fall injuries in Sweden occur in Dec-Mar; Afa Försäkring recommends halkskydd on frequently used entrances.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Independent slip-class test on ramp (DIN 51130 R-class; est. EUR 800-1,500, ASSUMPTION) with frost-thaw and salt ageing, which cheap imported mats lack; EU registered design for the tread pattern/interlock EUR 350. B2B contracts with housing associations. Honest: R-class is a classification many floor products carry; mats could pay the same fee, so the moat is moderate.
ideas.trend_evidence: Chalmers/Trafikverket report: nearly two in three serious pedestrian fall injuries occur Dec-Mar; Afa recommends halkskydd on frequent entrances. TV4 cites ~6,600 emergency visits a year from ice/snow falls (source not stated, Low). Existing consumer broddar tests (Testfakta) show buyers read tests. No source found for R-class or DIN 51130 use on step mats in Sweden.
ideas.channel_edge: Housing-association and property-manager relationships; Danish/Swedish hardware sellers. Seasonal: must ship before Oct.

ideas.name: Barefoot-wet slip-class bath/shower mat (DIN 51097 class C)
ideas.concept: Shower/bath mat made of grippy TPE/silicone with the DIN 51097 slip-class result and care-home-grade test report on the product; Nordic design in neutral colours; sized for small Nordic showers.
ideas.target_customer: Households with older relatives or children; care homes, housing associations and spas via B2B.
ideas.problem_solved: Bathroom slips. Most mats claim 'non-slip' without a standard; DIN 51097 is the barefoot-wet test used for pool and leisure mats.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Paid DIN 51097 class C report (est. EUR 500-1,200, ASSUMPTION) plus EU registered design for the pad pattern EUR 350. Honest limit: Kaiserkraft and EHA already sell class C roll mats; consumer-priced class C mats were not found but no retailer sweep was done. Moat is moderate-low.
ideas.trend_evidence: DIN 51097 classes A-C and C at >=24 degrees; Kaiserkraft and EHA ManuPlast sell class C mats (professional). A SATRA article refers to a standard for bath/shower mats (number not confirmed). No consumer test of bath mats found (Stiftung Warentest/Tænk). Bolius notes most bathroom tiles become slippery when wet.
ideas.channel_edge: Shopify; B2B to care homes and housing associations; Amazon DE/SE with test report in A+ content.

ideas.name: Ice-rescue and skating safety kit with licensed endorsement
ideas.concept: Pre-assembled kit: ice claws on a neck cord, 20 m floating throw line in a hip pouch, whistle and a printed self-rescue card in Swedish/Danish, sold in a gift-ready box.
ideas.target_customer: Swedish/Danish long-distance skaters, ice-fishers, snowmobilers and families on lakes (season Dec-Mar).
ideas.problem_solved: Falling through ice; separate rescue items are sold in separate shops and cheap versions are weak.
ideas.moat_mechanism: Weak unless a licence is won: exclusive endorsement/licence from Svenska Livräddningssällskapet or Sjöräddningssällskapet (ASSUMPTION; not offered; unconfirmed) plus independent pull test of rope and claws (EUR 500-1,000, ASSUMPTION). Without the licence defensibility drops to 2. Registered design EUR 350 for pouch layout.
ideas.trend_evidence: SLS guidance names ice picks, lifeline, isdubbar and flotation as the kit; Jula sells Fladen isdubbar with whistle at 99.90 SEK; varuste.net sells throw lines at EUR 27.90-29.90 and several isdubbar models for skaters. SLS notes isdubbar may not grip soft ice.
ideas.channel_edge: Skating clubs, outdoor retailers, Shopify; seasonal; no founder edge.

ideas.name: Cordless retrofit for roof-window pleated blinds (EN 16434-tested safety device)
ideas.concept: Retrofit handle/spring-motor set that converts corded roof-window blinds to cordless, with EN 16433/16434 test report; sold per window size family.
ideas.target_customer: Parents with roof-window blinds in children's rooms; landlords and housing associations.
ideas.problem_solved: Blind cords are a child strangulation hazard; EN 16433/16434 define the safety-device tests.
ideas.moat_mechanism: EN 16434 requirements and tests for safety devices (EUR 1.5-3k, ASSUMPTION), plus EU registered design EUR 350 and utility model on the handle mechanism; compatibility by window model is knowledge built on the founders' ex-VELUX background (not a legal moat). Honest: low confidence in demand, compatibility with VELUX original parts is unverified, and the original manufacturer could respond.
ideas.trend_evidence: EU Implementing Decision 2014/531 recognised EN 16433 and EN 16434; Irish CCPC and NSAI publish blind-safety warnings. No Swedish/Danish data found. No product gap verified.
ideas.channel_edge: Ex-VELUX knowledge of fit by model; installers; Shopify.
